artifacts.rights_basis: The ancient work and translation are public domain. The edition was published in 1880, and its editor Henry Barclay Swete died in 1917; the historical reservation notice has expired. Google scanning notices and watermarks document delivery provenance rather than subsisting rights in the public-domain edition.
